en: The image is an old monochrome postcard depicting a canal filled with traditional sailboats. The canal is flanked by historic buildings, and there is a visible old stamp mark in the upper area. The text 'Alexandrie.' is printed in the top right, and 'Canal Mahmoudieh' is printed at the bottom. The left margin has vertical text indicating 'Cliché Mail. Alexandrie.' There is also a handwritten signature or note on the right side.
